notes: Rose and Diamond levels with textured circles and matching bars. Rose: 5.5 Gym/Yoga, 8.5 Overall. Diamond: 6.5 Gym/Yoga, 10 Overall. Gym credits: 0.25 + 0.05 per set through 15 sets, then linearly to 1.2 at 20 sets. Yoga: 0.25 + 0.025 per minute through 30 minutes, then linearly to 1.2 at 45 minutes. Empty sessions earn zero. Overall still weights yoga at 75%. Historical totals recalculate without changing logged workouts or drafts.
